description: On a writable copy of the props fixture, an empty string is inserted with dbFailOnError (DBEngine.Errors after each) into ZlOn (AllowZeroLength set True), into ZlOff (set False) and into Req (Required True, AllowZeroLength never set). Afterwards ID, Req, ZlOn, ZlOff and the Len of each are read.
retentionNote: Designed r-cat-1b probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
